prompt: Can you guide me through training a custom ESRGAN model for upscaling game textures?
response: Training a custom ESRGAN model for game textures involves preparing a dataset of low and high-resolution images, setting up the ESRGAN architecture, and training the model using appropriate loss functions. Use perceptual loss and adversarial loss to guide the training. After training, apply the model to upscale game textures, ensuring to fine-tune hyperparameters for optimal results.
